name: 1P-MIPLA
summary: 1P-MiPLA, also known as 1-propanoyl-lysergic acid methylisopropylamide (1-propanoyl-MiPLA), is a designer drug and presumed serotonergic psychedelic of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). It is the 1-propanoyl derivative of MiPLA and may act as a prodrug of MiPLA. 1P-MiPLA has been discussed on specialized online forums since 2018.

pharmacology.text: 1P-MiPLA, also known as 1-propanoyl-lysergic acid methylisopropylamide (1-propanoyl-MiPLA), is a designer drug and presumed serotonergic psychedelic of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). It is the 1-propanoyl derivative of MiPLA and may act as a prodrug of MiPLA.

uses.text: 1P-MiPLA, also known as 1-propanoyl-lysergic acid methylisopropylamide (1-propanoyl-MiPLA), is a designer drug and presumed serotonergic psychedelic of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD).

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the lysergamides such as LSD, cause strong changes in perception and mood, and can bring anxiety, panic, confusion, a faster heartbeat and nausea. In some people they can trigger lasting mental health problems.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同族的麥角醯胺類藥物（例如LSD）會強烈改變知覺與情緒，也可能帶來焦慮、恐慌、意識混亂、心跳加快與噁心。對部分人可能引發長期的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同族的麦角酰胺类药物（例如LSD）会强烈改变知觉与情绪，也可能带来焦虑、恐慌、意识混乱、心跳加快与恶心。对部分人可能引发长期的心理健康问题。

fact.en: MiPLA, its presumed active form, is an LSD relative with two different groups on the amide nitrogen, one methyl and one isopropyl, instead of LSD's two matching ethyls.
fact.zh: 它推定的活性形式MiPLA是LSD的近親，醯胺氮上帶的是兩個不同的基團（一個甲基和一個異丙基），而不是LSD的兩個相同乙基。
fact.zhHans: 它推定的活性形式MiPLA是LSD的近亲，酰胺氮上带的是两个不同的基团（一个甲基和一个异丙基），而不是LSD的两个相同乙基。
